summary: Validated Supabase migration and Fan Wall end-to-end flows via pytest (13 cases) and Playwright on public URL.

integration_issues.flow: Fan Wall search immediately after submit-modal close
integration_issues.issue: UI automation observed search input populated but list request still sent with empty search in that sequence; backend search endpoint itself returns correct filtered data.

action_items: Main agent should manually verify search state update right after successful submit-close flow (possible timing/state sync issue).
Optional hardening: protect startup seed path when migrations are not yet applied to avoid crash loops on fresh environments.
critical_code_review_comments: startup seed_database() directly queries fan_wall_messages; if migrations are absent, app startup fails (seen in backend logs as UndefinedTableError).
Frontend emitted non-critical asset errors in browser logs (blocked external image/font 404); no API-critical console error observed.
test_credentials: No auth in current app; /app/memory/test_credentials.md states credentials are not required.
seed_data_creation: Created multiple test submissions via POST /api/fan-wall (stored as unapproved).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All required backend checks passed: root DB marker, Alembic revision 20260811_0001, fan_wall_messages/fan_wall_reactions existence, list/search/filter/sort/stats/submit/like dedupe/404 cases. UI filters and submit success state passed; only post-submit search sync looked inconsistent in automation sequence.
rca of the issue: Potential frontend state-sync/timing issue around debounced search + refreshKey updates after submit success. Backend logs show requests with empty search in that sequence, while direct API search with same term returns [].
